CFML Language Reference: Functions

Randomize

Seeds the random number generator used by Rand and RandRange with an integer, so that the numbers that follow form a predictable sequence. Also returns the first random number of that sequence.

Category

Mathematical functions

Syntax

Randomize(number)

Parameters

number
An integer seed. Any fractional part is discarded.

Returns

A random number between 0 and 1, the same one for the same seed.

Usage

You do not need Randomize to get random numbers; the generator seeds itself. Use it when you want the same "random" results every time, for example for a repeatable test or a "puzzle of the day" seeded with the date. The seed lasts for the rest of the request.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFSET Seed = Year(Now()) * 1000 + DayOfYear(Now())>
<CFSET First = Randomize(Seed)>
<CFSET Pick1 = RandRange(1, 49)>
<CFSET Again = Randomize(Seed)>
<CFSET Pick2 = RandRange(1, 49)>
<CFOUTPUT>
<P>Seeded with #Seed#: first number #First#, then lucky number #Pick1#.
<P>Seeded again with #Seed#: first number #Again#, then lucky number #Pick2#.
<P>Same both times? #YesNoFormat(First EQ Again AND Pick1 EQ Pick2)#. Come back tomorrow for a new lucky number.
</CFOUTPUT>

See also

Rand, RandRange
